name: Antique Agricultural Blower
description: The grain harvesting machine is a device used in rural areas to remove lighter impurities in grains, such as grains, weeds, etc. It consists of a container, an air outlet, a hand fan, and an outlet. When in use, put the grains in the container, connect the outlet to the container holding the grains, shake the hand fan, the lighter impurities will be blown out from the air outlet, and the grains will flow into the container holding the grains. When using the wind machine, people are prohibited from standing at the air outlet. Standing here may cause debris to easily blow into the eyes.
